# sneaking at an untamed camel opens its screen: the mount entity, no chest columns, the saddle and armor slots
MENU A cid=1 type=none state=1 carried=empty
MS 2 minecraft:saddle*1
MS 3 minecraft:leather_horse_armor*1
MS 4 minecraft:apple*30
MS 29 minecraft:saddle*1
MS 30 minecraft:iron_horse_armor*1
MS 31 minecraft:white_carpet*3
MS 32 minecraft:stick*5
MS 33 minecraft:cactus*20
PKT A minecraft:mount_screen_open 2a010000000065
PKT A minecraft:container_set_content 12010126000001b507000001830b00001eef07000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000001b507000001ff0a000003c404000005a4080000149d0300000000000000
